Both with v2 sockets: wall ≥ 3.0, floor ≥ 3.0, a bell mouth (Ø3.2 to Ø5.2 over the last 2.0) and a mouth collar (+1.0 over 3.0); saddle ties 14 deep. The concept review was not run: this worker cannot spawn the review agent; the two options are weighed here.

Breaking order

  1. A rod buckles (elastic, it springs back): 25 of 55 do in the 35 g crash (frame model v3, F). The rods are the fuse there, and every node holds each rod's push and pull (frame, F) at the crash allowable.
  2. A rod pulls out of its socket when its bond lets go (8 mm of contact, 482 N E; ties 12 mm, 724 N E), under the frame's largest pulls (to 1264 N, F): re-glue.

The TPU caps and the ring nodes take the landing; the camera mount's clips stay the camera's own fuse.
